newsitem.title: USA: Amerco shares drop after dismal Q3.
newsitem.headline: Amerco shares drop after dismal Q3.

text.p: Shares of Amerco Inc dropped after the company's third quarter earnings fell short of Wall Street estimates, analysts said Thursday.
Amerco, which rents trucks and trailers under the U-Haul brand name, posted a third quarter loss of $0.74 a share compared to a profit of $0.13 last year.
On a consensus basis, analysts expected Amerco to post a loss of $0.18 a share for the third quarter ended December 31, according to First Call, which tracks analysts estimates.
"Some analysts out there expected them to post break-even results, so when they came in at a loss, people just traded down," said Van Kasper & Co analyst Ian Gilson.
Amerco executives told analysts in a conference call that results for January were "back on track," with U-Haul operations were slightly ahead of projections, Gilson said.
